text: Using multi-template margin signals elicited from the frozen strong base model (8 templates), we trained qwen2.5-3b as the strong student from gpt2-medium weak supervision, averaging over 6 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.52 accuracy and the strong model's own ceiling was 0.87, while the weak-to-strong transfer accuracy was 0.78 with a standard error of 0.03. The resulting performance gap recovered was 0.73 with a standard error of 0.1, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.42; the margin between the two exceeds twice the reported standard error, so the method outperforms the baseline under this comparison. Two caveats temper the interpretation: no standard error is reported for the baseline PGR, so the comparison rests on the method's own dispersion alone, and the PGR standard error of 0.1 is sizeable relative to the span between baseline and treatment. Results are from a single model pair and one elicitation method, so generality to other pairings remains untested.
